description: Steam Summer Sale, as expected, brings deep discounts on several popular games. Games like The Witcher 3, Far Cry 4, Ghostwire Tokyo, Dishonored, A Plague Tale: Innocence, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 have received a 90 percent discount.
title: Steam Summer Sale 2026 Best Deals: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, Resident Evil Requiem, Black Ops 7 and More

description: Microsoft's consumer ESU programme for Windows 10 users was set to provide security updates until October this year. However, Microsoft has now quietly extended the programme by another year. As a result, eligible Windows 10 users will continue to receive security updates through October 12, 2027. An existing ESU license can be used to cover up to 10 devices.  Devices running on Windows 10, version 22H2 Home, Professional, Pro Education or Workstations edition are eligible to join the consumer Windows 10 ESU programme.
title: Microsoft Extends Windows 10 Extended Security Updates for Another Year Despite Pushing Users to Update to Windows 11

description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) announced a strategic partnership with Swedish music streaming platform Spotify on Friday to expand the entertainment experiences for postpaid subscribers in India. As part of the move, eligible Vi users will receive complimentary access to Spotify Premium for three months, gaining access to features like ad-free music streaming, offline downloads, and high-quality audio playback. The offer is available across select Vi Individual and Family Postpaid plans beginning today.
title: Vodafone Idea (Vi) Partners Spotify to Offer Postpaid Users Free Spotify Premium Access

description: Apple could launch an iPad Mini with an OLED display soon. Samsung Display has now reportedly started the mass production of OLED panels for the iPad Mini. The display manufacturing company has also begun the production of OLED panels for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Manufacturing of OLED panels for Apple's first foldable iPhone is said to begin later this month.
title: Samsung Display Reportedly Starts OLED Panel Production for iPad Mini, iPhone 18 Pro Series

description: Vivo Y6a has been launched in China as the tech firm’s latest Y series handset. The new Y series phone is on sale via the Vivo China online store in Galaxy Silver, Obsidian Black, and Phoenix Welcomes Gold (translated from Chinese) colour options.  The handset sports a 6.75-inch HD+ (720 x 1,570 pixels) LCD touchscreen, offering up to 120Hz refresh rate, up to 1,200 nits peak brightness, 256 ppi pixel density, 240Hz touch sampling rate, 83 percent NTSC, and 16.7 million colours. The company claims that the phone ships with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. It features a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset.
title: Vivo Y6a Launched With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus N6 will be launched in India with a flat display that refreshes at up to 120Hz and offers up to 1,200 nits peak brightness, the smartphone maker revealed on Friday. Moreover, the smartphone will feature a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter and an unspecified secondary camera. On the front, the OnePlus N6 will be equipped with an 8-megapixel camera for selfies and video calls. The company claims that the handset will be capable of recording videos at up to 60 fps, while also offering Dual-View video mode. For thermal management, the OnePlus N6 will launch equipped with a vapour chamber cooling solution, offering a 5,300 sq mm heat dissipation area.
title: OnePlus N6 Display, Camera Configuration and Other Key Details Confirmed Days Before India Launch

description: Prediction market platform Polymarket has confirmed that users affected by a phishing attack stemming from a compromised third-party vendor will be fully refunded. Blockchain analyst Specter estimated that attackers stole nearly $2.94 million worth of cryptocurrency from at least 11 wallets after a malicious script was injected into the platform's website. Polymarket said the affected dependency has been removed and described the incident as isolated.
title: Polymarket Reports $2.9 Million Theft, Says Customers Will Be Refunded

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro is expected to be in the works. The Xiaomi sub-brand has not yet officially revealed the arrival of this phone. However, it has received the 3C (China Compulsory Certification). The listing reveals the charging speed of the phone. The Redmi Note 17 Pro is expected to come with upgrades over the Redmi Note 15 Pro. The upcoming phone could pack a 9,000mAh battery and run on a Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Reportedly Listed With Charging Specifications on China's 3C Certification Database

description: Vivo X Fold 6 has been launched in China as the smartphone maker's latest book-style foldable. The new handset was unveiled by the company during its June 2026 launch event. The smartphone is set to go on sale in the country on July 1 via the Vivo online store. It is offered in Blue Hole, Polar Night, and Salt Lake (translated from Chinese) colour options. The new foldable is equipped with an 8.02-inch Samsung M14 foldable AMOLED display on the inside and a 6.51-inch cover screen. The Vivo X Fold 6 is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super chipset.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 8.02-Inch Samsung M14 Foldable Display: Price, Specifications

description: OnMobile Global marked its foray into India’s cloud gaming market with the launch of ONMO+ on Friday. It is a cloud gaming platform that combines a hardware bundle, which the company refers to as a Smart Console, using which players stream games from remote servers to compatible devices over the internet. Through a bundled subscription, users can access games running custom-built GPU servers, deployed across the northern and southern parts of the country.
title: ONMO+ Cloud Gaming Platform Launched in India With Pro Controller, 3-Month Subscription

description: Google on Thursday announced the Google Finance app for Android. It allows users to track watchlists, monitor real-time market data, and receive AI-generated insights. The company will also expand its capabilities to bring features like live earnings calls and today’s new portfolio in the coming months. Alongside, the web experience has been upgraded with new portfolio management tools. Google says users can now access scheduled market briefings powered by AI.
title: Google Finance App for Android Announced With AI Portfolio Tools, Real-Time Market Updates

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is now up for pre-order on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. The game is also getting a physical release, but the edition will not include discs. A retail insider has now claimed that Rockstar Games will release a disc version of the game in December.
title: GTA 6 Is Skipping Disc Version at Launch, but Proper Physical Release Will Reportedly Follow in December

description: Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship mobile processors could launch earlier than anticipated. According to a tipster, the US-based chipmaker is developing multiple Snapdragon 8-series processors based on both 2nm and 3nm manufacturing processes. They are tipped to be equipped with Qualcomm's next-generation Oryon CPU cores alongside updated Adreno GPUs and support for faster memory standards. The tipster also shed light on MediaTek's upcoming Dimensity 9600 Pro, claiming that it could rival Qualcomm's flagship silicon in GPU performance.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Details Leak as Tipster Reveals Anticipated Rivals to MediaTek's Flagship Chips

description: Bitcoin traded near $60,400 on Friday after hotter-than-expected US inflation data triggered a sharp selloff across crypto markets. Analysts said nearly $600 million in liquidations, continued institutional caution, and a $10 billion options expiry have heightened near-term volatility, although the slowdown in Bitcoin ETF outflows suggests selling pressure may be easing.
title: Bitcoin Trades Below $61,000 as Crypto Investors Grapple With Inflation Worries

description: Apple is revamping its Apple Silicon strategy, according to a report citing people with knowledge of the matter. The company reportedly plans to skip the launch of the M6 Pro and M6 Max processors, which were expected to launch early next year. Instead, the iPhone maker is expected to unveil the rumoured M7 Pro and M7 Max chips. Apple’s high-end M7 series processors are said to debut in 2027. The Apple Silicon M7 Pro and M7 Max chips are claimed to offer more advanced computing and graphics power, which will enable on-device AI capabilities in the future, while allowing them to run more graphics-intensive tasks.
title: Apple Said to Skip M6 Pro, M6 Max Processors to Prioritise Development of AI-Focused M7 Chipsets

description: Apple is reportedly developing a smart ring, dubbed "iRing." The leak is brief and does not include features of the launch timeline for this product. The new model is likely to rival the popular Oura Ring series and Samsung Galaxy Ring. Samsung launched its first smart ring, the Galaxy Ring, in 2024. It costs Rs. 38,999 and is available in nine sizes. Apple's smart ring is expected to offer many health and fitness tracking features.
title: Apple Said to Be Readying iRing to Challenge Samsung Galaxy Ring, Oura Ring

description: After launching the Reno 16 series in China, Oppo has launched the phones in global markets. The series includes Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, and Reno 16F. Both the Reno 16 and Reno 16 Pro are equipped with a 6,000mAh battery that supports 80W fast charging. The Reno 16F features a 7,000mAh cell with the same charging support. The trio offers IP69K ratings for resistance against dust and water and is pre-installed with ColorOS 16.
title: Oppo Reno 16F, Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro Launched With 50-Megapixel Cameras, 80W Fast Charging: Price, Specifications

description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 series has been in the rumour mill recently. Following previous reports that a new Pro model could join the flagship lineup next year, fresh evidence corroborating the same has been discovered on a certification platform. Three unreleased Galaxy S27 series models have been sighted, including the purported Galaxy S27 Pro. The listing also mentions the Galaxy S27 Plus and Galaxy S27 Ultra, which are expected to be a part of the next-generation flagship Galaxy S lineup alongside the vanilla Galaxy S27.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro Makes an Early Visit to the GSMA Database Alongside Galaxy S27 Plus, Galaxy S27 Ultra

description: Layoffs have hit Bungie once again, with cuts impacting most of the Destiny team and some Marathon team members. Sony announced the layoffs on Thursday and said cuts were made after “extensive discussion and careful consideration.”
title: Sony Announces Layoffs at Bungie With Cuts Impacting Most of the Destiny Team

description: Leaks continue to shed light on Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8 lineup. A new leak suggests that the standard Galaxy Z Fold 8 could weigh as little as 201g. It is said to feature a less prominent display crease than the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra are expected to go official on July 22. The new foldable phones are said to be available for purchase starting August 7.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Weight and Display Crease Details Revealed in a New Leak, Sale Date Tipped

description: Apple has hiked the prices of multiple devices, including the newly launched entry-level MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and Pro with M5 chips, Mac Mini with the M4 chip, and iPad models, and other smart home devices. However, the company has yet to increase the prices of its smartphones, true wireless studio (TWS), headphones, and smartwatches. This means that you can still get the iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air, iPhone 17e, iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, Watch Series 11, Watch SE 3, Watch Ultra 3, AirPods 4 series, AirPods Pro 3, and AirPods Ultra at older prices.
title: Beat the Apple Price Hike: Every Product You Can Still Buy at Old Prices in India

description: Nothing Phone 4b is scheduled to launch as the first handset in the new “b” series next month. The company recently showcased the design of the phone, while also revealing a blue colourway. While details still remain under wraps, a tipster has leaked key specifications of the upcoming handset. It is tipped to sport a 6.7-inch 120Hz display. The Nothing Phone 4b could be powered by a 6-series processor from Qualcomm, backed by a battery with a capacity exceeding the 5,000mAh mark.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Key Specifications Tipped; May Get 120Hz Screen, 50-Megapixel Camera

description: Microsoft on Thursday announced that starting August 1, the Xbox Series S/X consoles will cost more globally. The US-based tech giant has significantly raised the prices of both consoles, increasing the cost of the 512GB models by $100 (roughly Rs. 9,500). On the other hand, starting August 1, the 1TB models of both consoles will sell at a premium of a whopping $150 (about Rs. 14,000). Interestingly, while raising the prices of the other two variants, the tech giant discontinued the top-of-the-line 2TB option.
title: Microsoft Xbox Series S/X Console Prices Hiked Globally By Up to $150; 2TB Storage Variant Gets the Axe

description: Apple on Thursday increased the prices of several products in India and global markets, with some products seeing price hikes of up to Rs. 1 lakh. The revision applies to devices across categories, including Mac computers, MacBook, iPad, Apple TV, and HomePod. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has revised prices across much of its hardware portfolio, the iPhone lineup remains untouched for now. The move comes weeks after Apple CEO Tim Cook warned that soaring memory and storage prices had made price increases "unavoidable".
title: Apple's Price Hike Hits Macs, iPads, Apple TV and HomePod in India; iPhones Spared for Now
